label: Diagram 4.1
caption: Diagram 4.1 Type B, plan view showing minimum dimensions
description: This is a plan view, titled "Diagram 4.1 Type B, plan view showing minimum dimensions", of a rectangular toilet room, with the fixtures arranged along the top wall and the door on the right-hand wall. Along the top wall, from left to right, are a "Shelf" at the left end, a "Space for disposal bin" measured 540mm from the left wall and 210mm deep, an "HD" hand-drying facility, a washbasin 400mm wide, a 100mm dimension between the washbasin and the hooks, and "High hook and low hook" with a 250mm vertical dimension. The total top run is "1685mm minimum". The left vertical dimension reads "1050mm minimum" and the right vertical dimension reads "650mm", the latter marking the width of the WC activity space, with an "Activity space" label at the top right. In the lower left a WC is drawn, with its cistern, labelled "Column of clearance", against the left wall and the bowl extending to the right; a dashed 465mm Ø turning circle is drawn in the centre over the shaded WC activity space, and the column of clearance is offset from the centre line. A door swings into the room from the right wall. A key defines green as "Activity space WC" and pale green as "Activity space washbasin", plus "HD Hand-drying facility". Four notes follow, referring to Appendix D, a concealed cistern, the off-centre clearance column avoiding the door swing, and centring the WC on its activity space width.

Along the top wall, left to right, are a "Shelf", a "Space for disposal bin" (540mm wide, 210mm deep), an "HD" hand-drying facility, and a washbasin with two taps (400mm, with a 100mm segment), followed by "High hook and low hook" (250mm). The total top run is "1685mm minimum". The left vertical dimension reads "1050mm minimum" and the right "650mm", marking an "Activity space". In the lower centre a WC with cistern is drawn, with a dashed 465mm Ø turning circle over a shaded "Column of clearance" that is offset from centre. A door swings into the space from the right. A key defines green as "Activity space WC" and pale green as "Activity space washbasin", plus "HD Hand-drying facility". Four notes follow, referring to Appendix D, a concealed cistern, the off-centre clearance column avoiding the door swing, and centring the WC on its activity space width.
